en: When central banks raise interest rates, it’s big news The bank is judging...
zh: 當央行提高利率時，這可是件大事。央行認為……

en: ...that the only way they can try to pull down inflation...
zh: 他們唯一能做的……

en: ...is to carry on raising interest rates We’re going to see rising rates
zh: 就是繼續提高利率，以此抑制通膨。我們將看到利率上升。利率上升會導致

en: Rising interest rates that will make the cost of borrowing go up It can send ripples across the whole economy
zh: 借貸成本上升，這會對整個經濟產生連鎖反應，

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: It can sink consumer confidence...
zh: 打擊消費者信心…

en: ...result in fewer jobs and lower wages, and cause stock prices to fall
zh: 導致就業減少、薪資下降，並引發股價下跌。

en: If they go too far too fast, it can tip economies into recession
zh: 如果升息幅度過大過快，甚至可能使經濟陷入衰退。

en: So why do central banks raise interest rates?
zh: 那麼，央行為什麼要提高利率呢？

en: Let’s start with the basics If you borrow money, you’ll have to pay back a little extra...
zh: 讓我們從基礎知識開始。如果你借錢，就得額外償還一些…

en: ...to make it worthwhile for the lender Well, I think we can make you this loan, you have a good reputation...
zh: 才能讓貸款方覺得划算。嗯，我想我們可以給你這筆貸款，你信譽良好……

en: ...we know you’re reliable I’m glad you think so This is the interest rate So if you are taking out a loan...
zh: 我們知道你很可靠。很高興你也這麼認為。這就是利率。所以，如果你要貸款……你肯定希望利率

en: ...you want the interest rate to be as low as possible...
zh: 越低越好……

en: ...so you don’t have to pay that much back On the flip side, if you want to save money...
zh: 這樣你就不用還那麼多錢。另一方面，如果你想存錢…

en: ...then a high interest rate means you can earn more on your savings See it as a reward for leaving money in your account
zh: 那麼高利率意味著你的存款可以賺取更多收益。你可以把它看作是把錢留在帳戶裡的獎勵。

en: But the size of your reward depends on the circumstances There’s no single interest rate in the economy
zh: 但獎勵的大小取決於具體情況。經濟中沒有統一的利率。

en: You’ve got thousands of banks setting their own commercial rates
zh: 成千上萬家銀行都在設定自己的商業利率。

en: That’s all influenced, though, by the interest rate that the central bank sets
zh: 不過，所有這些都受到中央銀行設定的利率的影響。

en: A central bank is like a bank for banks Just like you and your savings account...
zh: 中央銀行就像銀行的銀行。就像你和你的儲蓄帳戶一樣

en: ...banks also earn interest when they leave money with the central bank Commercial banks have these things called reserves
zh: …銀行把錢存在中央銀行也能賺取利息。商業銀行有叫做準備金的東西。

en: So that’s a bit like their cash on hand Commercial banks lend those excess reserves to each other at an interest rate...
zh: 這有點像他們的現金儲備。商業銀行會把這些多餘的準備金貸款出去。銀行之間以一定的利率相互交換儲備金……

en: ...and they also can deposit their excess reserves at the central bank And when they do that, they can earn an interest rate
zh: 他們也可以將超額儲備金存入中央銀行。這樣做可以賺取利息。

en: Ordinary people can’t access the interest rate on the excess reserves...
zh: 一般民眾無法獲得超額儲備金的利息……

en: ...but it still affects them And that’s the idea When central banks raise interest rates...
zh: 但這仍然會影響到他們。這就是中央銀行提高利率的原理……

en: ...they’re trying to control inflation—how fast prices rise for everyone
zh: 他們試圖控制通貨膨脹——也就是所有人的物價上漲速度。一英鎊之前是

notes.zh: keep control over...：掌控某人或某事
notes.example: Staying calm helps you keep control over the conversation.

en: They were £1.29, now they’re £1.39, and that’s in the space of four weeks
zh: 1.29英鎊，現在是1.39英鎊，而這只發生在短短四周內。

en: Central banks like the Fed or the Bank of England or the European Central Bank...
zh: 像聯準會、英格蘭銀行或歐洲中央銀行這樣的中央銀行

en: ...are all trying to hit an inflation target of 2% Interest rates are a really powerful tool that they have to do that
zh: …都在努力實現2%的通膨目標。利率是他們實現這一目標的有力工具。

en: If inflation is seen as too high, that’s when banks raise interest rates
zh: 如果通膨被認為過高，銀行就會提高利率。利率的

en: The change spreads through the financial system and slows down the rate of inflation Here’s how
zh: 變動會擴散到整個金融體系，進而減緩通貨膨脹率。具體來說，

en: A rise in interest rates from a central bank...
zh: 中央銀行提高利率

en: ...means that a commercial bank will earn more on their reserves
zh: ……意味著商業銀行將從其儲備金中獲得更多收益。

en: They might make more from keeping their money in a central bank than lending it out
zh: 他們把錢存在中央銀行可能比放款更賺錢。

en: So if they do lend it out, they’ll raise their interest rates...
zh: 因此，如果他們放貸，就會提高利率。利率……

en: ...to make it worth their while How that affects consumers depends on the economy Take mortgages
zh: 為了讓他們覺得值得。這對消費者的影響取決於經濟狀況。以抵押貸款為例。

en: In places like Finland or Australia...
zh: 在芬蘭或澳洲等地

en: ...lots of people have mortgages with variable interest rates
zh: …許多人的抵押貸款利率是浮動利率。

en: If you’ve got a variable-rate mortgage, where the interest rate that you pay...
zh: 如果你持有浮動利率抵押貸款，即你支付的利率…

en: ...is linked to the central bank’s interest rate...
zh: 與央行利率掛鉤

en: ...then higher interest rates mean that, essentially, immediately...
zh: …那麼更高的利率意味著，基本上，

en: ...the higher rate will translate into less cash to spend on other things Less spare cash means households will spend less
zh: 利率上升會立即轉化為更少的現金用於其他用途。可支配現金減少意味著家庭支出減少。

en: And less spending means businesses will be warier of raising prices This should lower inflation
zh: 支出減少意味著企業在漲價時會更加謹慎。這應該會降低通貨膨脹。

en: In other countries, like America or Canada...
zh: 在其他國家，例如美國或加拿大

en: ...a bigger share of mortgages are set at fixed rates People with fixed rates are protected...
zh: …更大比例的抵押貸款採用固定利率。擁有固定利率的人可以

en: ...against the direct effects of an interest rate rise...
zh: 免受利率上升的直接影響……

en: ...but will still feel an indirect impact Higher interest rates mean that mortgages will become more expensive
zh: 但仍然會感受到間接影響。更高的利率意味著抵押貸款將變得更加昂貴。

en: If that is affecting all new buyers, then house prices will begin to fall
zh: 如果這影響到所有新購屋者，那麼房價將開始下跌。

notes.zh: on the house：店家請客、免費招待
notes.example: Sorry for the wait—dessert is on the house.

en: And that will make everyone who owns a home feel poorer...
zh: 這將使每個擁有住房的人感覺更窮……

en: ...and therefore they might spend less Lower spending will translate into lower inflation
zh: 因此他們可能會減少支出。支出減少將轉化為通貨膨脹降低。

en: And it’s not just consumers who will tighten the purse strings When interest rates rise...
zh: 不只是消費者會勒緊褲帶。當利率上升時利率上升

en: ...then businesses will find it more expensive to borrow and invest That generally means less economic activity
zh: …企業借貸和投資成本就會增加。這通常意味著經濟活動減少，也可能意味著新增就業機會減少。

en: It might mean fewer jobs are created
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Fewer jobs and lower wages could mean less money for households...
zh: 就業減少和薪資下降可能意味著家庭收入減少…

en: ...and consumer confidence might suffer Which also means less spending
zh: 消費者信心也可能受到打擊，進而導致支出減少。

en: People are grappling with a decline in real wages...
zh: 人們正在努力應對實際工資下降……這

en: ...meaning their money buys less When interest rates rise, that will tend to slow down spending, investment...
zh: 意味著他們的錢購買力下降。利率上升往往會減緩支出和投資

en: ...and generally depress economic activity
zh: …並普遍抑制經濟活動。

en: Overall that will make businesses more reluctant to raise their prices...
zh: 總而言之，這將使企業更不願意提高價格…從而

en: ...and that will tend to pull back inflation It sounds straightforward, right?
zh: 抑制通貨膨脹。聽起來很簡單，對吧？

en: But the trick is judging how far to go In 1981, the Federal Reserve, America’s central bank...
zh: 但關鍵在於判斷升息的力度。 1981年，美國中央銀行聯準會

en: ...allowed interest rates to rise to a whopping 19%
zh: 允許利率飆升至驚人的19%。

en: The move curbed inflation, but it led to widespread economic pain
zh: 此舉抑制了通貨膨脹，但也導致了廣泛的經濟痛苦。

en: I regret to say that we’re in the worst economic mess since the Great Depression
zh: 遺憾的是，我們正處於自大蕭條以來最嚴重的經濟困境。

en: It is very difficult to get inflation under control...
zh: 控制通貨膨脹非常困難，

notes.zh: keep control over...：掌控某人或某事
notes.example: Staying calm helps you keep control over the conversation.

en: ...without severely denting economic activity
zh: 否則會嚴重損害經濟活動。

en: In America, it’s been over 70 years since they’ve managed to get inflation down...
zh: 在美國，70多年來，他們一直未能將通貨膨脹率

en: ...from over 5% without causing a recession A little inflation is OK
zh: 從5%以上降至較低水平，而沒有引發經濟衰退。適度的通貨膨脹是可以接受的，

en: It keeps the economy moving at a sensible speed But inflation staying high for too long is a problem
zh: 它能使經濟以合理的速度運作。但通貨膨脹長期居高不下則是個問題。

en: Higher prices means employees will need higher wages...
zh: 物價上漲意味著員工需要更高的薪資，從而

en: ...pushing up costs for businesses That could drive up prices further...
zh: 推高企業成本。這

en: ...potentially leading to an upward spiral of wages and prices Retail inflation in India has surged to 7.8%
zh: 可能會進一步推高物價，並可能導致工資和物價螺旋式上漲。印度的零售通膨率已飆升至7.8%。疲軟的

en: The combination of tepid economic activity and high inflation...
zh: 經濟活動和高通膨的結合，

en: ...poses serious challenges for the Indian economy going forward
zh: 對印度經濟的未來發展構成了嚴峻挑戰。央行官員非常關注如何設定

notes.zh: 向前（move forward：走出低谷繼續前進）
notes.example: Mistakes are just feedback to help us move forward.

en: Central bankers are really concerned about setting expectations of inflation
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: The idea is that, if it can show that it is credible...
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: ...that it will always act to get inflation back down to 2%...
zh: 通膨預期。他們的想法是，如果通膨能夠持續走低，那麼…它可信…

en: ...then maybe it won’t have to raise interest rates...
zh: 它會一直努力將通膨率降回

en: ...and then lower them in this kind of seesaw fashion Raising interest rates can slow an economy right down
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: The trouble is, the brake pedal has a delay It can take as long as two years...
zh: 2%…這樣或許就不必提高

en: ...to see the full results from interest rate changes Central banks know this So when they set interest rates...
zh: 利率…然後又像蹺蹺板一樣上下浮動利率。提高利率會嚴重拖慢經濟成長。

en: ...they’re actually trying to read the road ahead But predicting the future isn’t easy
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: The problem is it’s difficult for the central bank to work out...
zh: 問題在於，煞車踏板是有延遲的。利率變動的全部影響可能需要長達兩年的時間才能顯現。央行深知這一點。因此，

en: ...whether the inflation will fall back on its own And even when central banks do get it right...
zh: 當他們設定利率時…實際上是在試圖預測未來的走勢。但預測未來並非易事。問題在於，央行很難判斷…通膨是否會自行回落。即使央行預測正確

en: ...they might still cause a crash It may be a blunt instrument, but raising interest rates...
zh: …他們仍然可能導致經濟崩潰。

en: ...is still central banks’ main tool for taming inflation
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Central bankers would say that, yes, raising interest rates can be painful Slowing down the economy is not fun
zh: 提高利率或許是一種粗暴的手段，但它仍然是央行抑制通膨的主要工具。央行官員會說，是的，提高利率可能會很痛苦。放緩經濟成長並不輕鬆。

en: But it’s worth it It’s worth it to get low and steady inflation...
zh: 但這是值得的。

en: ...so that in the long run, you don’t have to think about it
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Thank you for watching To read more of our coverage on interest rates, click the link And don’t forget to subscribe
zh: 為了實現低而穩定的通膨……從長遠來看，這是值得的。不用想太多了。感謝觀看。想了解更多關於利率的報道，請點擊連結。別忘了訂閱！
